# Config Reference

## `config/config_culex_combine.yml`

All keys live under `default:`. Loaded in the pipeline via `config::get()`.

---

### Global Parameters

| Key | Type | Value | Purpose |
|-----|------|-------|---------|
| `path` | string | `"1_input"` | Root input directory |
| `year_start` | integer | `2006` | Earliest year included in skeleton expansion |
| `week_start` | integer | `23` | First ISO week of trapping season (late May) |
| `week_end` | integer | `37` | Last ISO week of trapping season (early Sept) |
| `na_col` | string | `"trap_id"` | Column name used for NA-drop in `filter_culex_sheet()` |
| `filter_active` | boolean | `TRUE` | Global flag — whether to restrict to active traps (overridden per-source) |

---

### Reference File Paths

| Key | Type | Value | Purpose |
|-----|------|-------|---------|
| `fn_trap_keep` | path | `"1_input/foco_trap - data.csv"` | Authoritative trap registry used by `filter_culex_sheet()` and `expand_trap()` |
| `fn_database` | path | `"1_input/wnv-s_database - data.csv"` | Historical pooled abundance (lowest-priority fallback source) |
| `fn_rename_col` | path | `"1_input/database_column_rename.csv"` | Column name lookup table used by `key_rename()` |

---

### Intermediate Output Paths (`2_mid/`)

| Key | Path | Contents |
|-----|------|---------|
| `mid_culex_clean_plot` | `2_mid/culex_clean_all_spp_plot.png` | All-species diagnostic bar chart after cleaning |
| `mid_culex0` | `2_mid/culex0_raw_rbind.csv` | Raw rbind of all sources before cleaning |
| `mid_database_reformat` | `2_mid/database_reformat.csv` | Database reshaped to culex-sheet format |
| `mid_culex_database` | `2_mid/culex_sheet_database_preaugment.csv` | Culex-filtered pre-join checkpoint |
| `mid_unmerged_data` | `2_mid/unmerged_data.csv` | Records not matched by `fill_skeleton()` (audit) |
| `mid_dropped_by_filter` | `2_mid/dropped_by_active_filter.csv` | Records excluded by active-trap filter (audit) |

---

### Final Output Paths (`3_output/`)

| Key | Path | Contents |
|-----|------|---------|
| `manifest` | `3_output/_manifest.txt` | Execution log — row counts, file counts, config snapshot |
| `output_culex_database_expand` | `3_output/culex_sheet_database_expand.csv` | **Main output** — full skeleton filled and status-resolved |

| `output_plot_comp` | `3_output/culex_v_datasheet.png` | Trap count vs. pool count comparison |
| `output_plot_n_trap` | `3_output/n_trap_per_wk_culex_sheet.png` | Trap counts by status and zone |

---

### Species & Zone Parameters

| Key | Type | Value | Purpose |
|-----|------|-------|---------|
| `spp_levels` | list | `["Tarsalis", "Pipiens"]` | Target species — `prep_for_skeleton()` ensures one row per level per trap-week |
| `filter_zone` | list | `["BC", "BE"]` | Zones excluded from the culex-vs-database comparison plot |
| `fc_zone` | list | `["NE", "NW", "SE", "SW"]` | Fort Collins zones that collapse to `zone2 = "FC"` in `wnv_s_clean()` |

---

### Per-Source Registry (`sources.*`)

Four sources declared. Priority in `fill_skeleton()`: **vdci → cmc_weekly → cfc → bc**.

Each source entry supports these keys:

| Key | Type | Required | Purpose |
|-----|------|----------|---------|
| `path` | string | yes | Directory to search recursively |
| `pattern` | string (regex) | yes | Passed to `list.files(pattern=..., ignore.case=TRUE)` |
| `pivot_fn` | string or null | yes | Name of reshape function to dispatch per file; null = already long |
| `filter_active` | boolean | yes | Whether to apply `filter_culex_sheet()` active-trap semi_join |
| `exclude_paths` | list | no | Path substrings to exclude from file discovery |
| `import_args` | map | no | Extra args forwarded to `rio::import()` (e.g. `sheet: "CombinedData"`) |

**Current source declarations:**

| Source | path | pattern | pivot_fn | filter_active |
|--------|------|---------|----------|---------------|
| `vdci` | `1_input/vdci` | `\.csv$` | null | true |
| `cmc_weekly` | `1_input/cmc` | `LC.*Week.*\.xls$` | `pivot_cmc` | true |
| `cfc` | `1_input/cfc` | `CFC_Full_Raw_Data.*\.xlsx$` | `pivot_cfc` | true |
| `bc` | `1_input/bc` | `(Boulder.*[Cc]ulex\|Abundance_Culex).*\.(csv\|xlsx)$` | `pivot_boulder` | false |

> **Note:** `cfc` also has `import_args: {sheet: "CombinedData"}` — required because the XLSX has multiple sheets.
> **Note:** Boulder (`bc`) has `filter_active: false` because BC submits only 6 pools and their trap list doesn't map to the `foco_trap` registry.
